name: audio-player
title: Audio Player
description: A compact track card with cover, play and pause, a seek slider with times and a mute toggle. It runs its own clock, so it needs no audio file.

props.name: artist
props.description: Artist or show line under the title.

props.name: cover
props.description: Artwork at the left. Defaults to a music note.

props.name: playing
props.description: Controlled play state. Pair with onPlayingChange.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Called by the button and when the track ends.

props.name: currentTime
props.description: Controlled position in seconds. Pair with onTimeChange.

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Called on every tick and seek; mirror it onto a real audio element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
